scope: Complete-or-capped Boolean normal-form V4 closure from four immutable parent layers; global LFD upper remains a separate gate

layout.protocol-degree4-quartic.json: Frozen instrument, twelve unchanged m3 identities, limits and four parent archives
layout.case-specs/KEY.json: Exact frozen case. propagation_case is the unchanged predecessor case; propagation_files binds eight predecessor payloads
layout.v2/ARM/ID/: Saved complete V2 basis, operations and result; fully replayed
layout.cases/KEY/added.rows.hybrid: New independent hybrid rows, each with its global insertion ID
layout.cases/KEY/blocked.row.hybrid: Same header; zero or one unadmitted row with ID u64::MAX. A partial reduction or payload-blocked independent remainder is retained but excluded from rank
layout.cases/KEY/operations.jsonl: Every attempted allowed variable product, ordered reducers, hashes, reduction status and insertion ID, including zero and blocked candidates
layout.cases/KEY/progress.jsonl: Append-only deterministic counters every32 attempts and at every clean stop
layout.cases/KEY/state.json: Caps, counts, next source, blocked operation, pending count and complete_v4_normal_forms
layout.cases/KEY/pending.json: Entire compact queue: both initial group row-ID lists, group/variable/index cursors, urgent row/next-variable tasks, total pending products
layout.cases/KEY/affine.json: Unit/linear global row IDs, free variables, all checked assignments and failed equation IDs. Enumeration only when at most12 free variables
layout.cases/KEY/result.json: Outcome plus frozen input binding and verified propagation parent hash
layout.controls/: Genuine quartic cancellation, positive xyz+1 and negative xyz. Includes original systems, independently enumerated dense V3/V4, hybrid traces and fresh replay checks
layout.development-validation/: All28 native tests and independent runtime control summary; earlier failed build log retained in source support
layout.summary.json: Native join of statuses and outcomes; numeric conclusions only for producer and fresh replay exit0
layout.status/summary-after-KEY.json: Write-once cumulative summary after each case
layout.logs/,replay/,host.txt,terminal.json: Process outcomes, non-secret host and diagnostic launcher boundaries; no timing comparison
layout.manifest.sha256: Hashes of every final raw payload except this inventory
layout.uploader.stop: Drains background upload before the final manifest and upload

record: quartic_nonzeros*u32le ascending distinct global column indices
hybrid_rows_binary.lower_block: Graded colex squarefree monomials through degree3; little-endian words, LSB-first bits; zero padding
hybrid_rows_binary.initial_basis: Complete V3 insertion IDs followed by predecessor propagation insertion IDs. Reconstruct only by verifying all four parents
hybrid_rows_binary.hash_value_bytes: quartic_nonzeros:u64le || dense lower block || ascending u32le quartic indices; excludes global row ID
hybrid_rows_binary.partial: A header or prefix does not assert completion. Successful full byte replay rejects truncation, alteration and trailing data

operations.attempt: Zero-based product attempt, including blocked attempt
operations.source_row: Existing global row ID with stored degree<=3
operations.variable: Zero-based variable index; ordinary product degree<=4
operations.xor_basis_rows: Ordered global reducer IDs; each reducer already admitted
operations.remainder_sha256: Canonical value bytes after the recorded full or partial reduction
operations.reduction_complete: False only if weight cap interrupts reduction; partially reduced row is saved separately
operations.inserted_row: Global ID or null for zero/blocked candidate
operations.blocked: Current source remains pending and no rank is charged
operations.membership_degree_bound: Always4; Boolean reductions are justified by original field equations

queue_order: Initial added-parent rows first, complete-V3 cubic rows second; variables outer, ascending row IDs inner. Every new degree<=3 row gets an urgent FIFO all-variable task. Advance old task before adding new one.
stopping: Unit, queue exhaustion, row cap, operation cap, or weight/payload block during an attempt. Unit precedes simultaneous boundaries. Every case attempted once; no automatic retries.

claims.complete_v4: All permitted products covered, no pending work or blocked operation; graded echelon argument proves complete Boolean normal-form image of V4
claims.global_upper: Only a unit in V4 or exhaustive affine ideal equality; complete V4 alone is insufficient
claims.exact_four: Inherited replayed strict lower4 plus certified global upper4
claims.caps: No cap or stall gives lower5 or global stabilization; null exact/upper remains unknown
claims.rank: Membership/span accounting only; not a factor-base quality ranking or regularity measure
claims.review: Producer/fresh/S3 replay does not constitute independent scientific review
